title: [Fixed Assets] Prevent change of FA Posting group after acquisition and FA journal cancellation line with empty Document No.
summary: Two Fixed Assets bugs are fixed: FA Posting Group field is now protected after acquisition posting, and FA journal cancellation creates a valid document number when the batch is not empty.
key_points: FA Posting Group validation now blocks changes after acquisition cost is posted, preventing G/L account mismatch
New CheckFAPostingGroupChangeAfterAcquisition validation prevents unguarded posting group modification
Cancel FA Ledger Entries now uses the last batch line's document number when creating cancellation entries in non-empty batches
Fixes applied across W1 and localized versions (DACH, FR, GB, RU)
Comprehensive test cases added to verify both correction scenarios
